findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/hooks/useUnitLists.test.tsx test shows a change made by someone else on the next move to another page, not before
findings.obligation: P8 falsifier: lists refresh on a timer or on every render instead of on the page move
findings.observation: The not-before check runs once, synchronously, right after theTeamsAre. No time passes and no reader re-renders, so a timer-based or render-based refresh is not observed before the move.
findings.remediation: After the change, advance a fake clock past the refetch interval and re-render the readers; assert the old list and teams asked once before the page move. Non-blocking for craft.
